It also gives participation directions, including lending Bitcoin, signing up through description links, and using a wallet to send Strong tokens. The warnings about crypto risk, fake sites, and seed-phrase requests provide protective context but do not remove the video's apparent promotional mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Purchased StrongBlock nodes and their claimed recurring rewards are central to the video, alongside a separate YieldNodes lending investment presented as producing monthly returns. The speaker also warns about fake sites requesting seed phrases; that warning is not part of either promoted offer.
